# K-gap diagnosis: the table (report only; generated by hitter_data.kgap_diag md)

K changes are percentage points. Variant rows = variant − as built over the same seeds (paired, game-clustered SE). Rows 0, a and a4 add up to the sims' gap (target -> count layer -> sims' per-count rates chained -> sims' K). Every other row is a K change when one piece is replaced (negative = that piece explains part of the gap); a-rows replace it in the per-count rates and chain (bootstrap SE over games). Replacement rows overlap; they are not additive.

## Off-speed command: ball and in-play rate per pitch by kind (world vs real)

World = the probe games' per-pitch probabilities: as thrown (engine's targets and landing) / with the real landing mix (Ps). Overall = averaged over the real count mix of that kind, so world and real weight counts alike. Real: HS = hs.sqlite3 2022-25 (high school + travel; every pitch with a count, ball four included, HBP rows in the denominator); college = Statcast Single-A 2021-25 (the count layer's landing population; no college pitch-type data); MLB = Statcast MLB 2025.
